transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. Can you tell me what’s been troubling you lately or what brings you here today?

Well... my wife actually thought I should come in. It’s just... I've been noticing things. For about a year now. 

She has these late meetings, and... I've seen little changes in her work messages. She says it’s just normal office stuff, but... I don't know. They just line up too precisely to feel accidental. It’s... it's like there’s a private signal in them. Like they're meant to tell me something she won’t just say directly. 

So... she wanted me to talk to someone about it. That's really all it is.
Do you believe that your wife is trying to communicate with you through hidden messages in her work messages?

I mean... yes. I suppose that's what I'm saying. I know she claims it's just normal office stuff, but... it's been a year of this. The late meetings, the specific wording she uses... it just lines up too perfectly. It doesn't feel accidental. It feels like... like she's trying to send me a private signal. Something she just won't come out and say directly to my face.
Have you noticed any other situations where you've felt someone was communicating with you through hidden signs or signals?
No. Um... no, not really. Just her. I don't... I don't really pay attention to other people's messages like that. It's just my wife.
Do you feel like these hidden signals from your wife are part of a bigger pattern that you're meant to understand, or do they seem like separate, isolated messages to you?

I don't really know. Um... I haven't thought about it like that. 

I'm not trying to piece together some... big puzzle or anything. It's just the messages themselves. I don't really know what they all add up to, if they even do. I just... I just know what I see in them. That's all.
Do you ever have thoughts or beliefs that others might find unusual or hard to understand, outside of what you’ve described about your wife’s messages?
No. Not really. I mean... I just go to work, do my job, come home. I don't really have time for... unusual thoughts, I guess. It's just this thing with my wife. That's all.
Do you ever believe things that others might not believe, even when there's no clear evidence to support those beliefs?
No. I don't... I don't really operate like that. If I believe something, it's because I can see it happening. I don't just make things up without proof. So... no. Just what I've already told you.
Have you ever had a strong belief about something that turned out not to be true, even though you were absolutely sure it was at the time?
No. I... I can't think of anything like that. Um... usually, if I'm sure about something, it's because it's real. I don't really jump to conclusions. So, no.
Have you ever had a belief that you know is completely true, but others have told you it’s not real or doesn’t make sense?

Well... I mean, she tells me it's not real. My wife, I mean. She says the late meetings and... the little changes in how she writes her work messages... she says it's just normal office stuff. But... I don't know. For the past year, it just... it lines up too precisely. It doesn't feel accidental. It's like... like there's a private signal in them. Meant to tell me something she won't just say directly. But she says I'm wrong.
Have you ever had a belief that you hold strongly, even though others have been unable to see it or agree with you, outside of what you've described about your wife's messages?
No. Not really. Just... just the thing with her. That's all.
Have you ever had a belief that you know is true, but there is no physical evidence to support it, and others have told you it doesn't make sense?
No, I... I already told you. It's just the thing with my wife. I don't... I don't have anything else like that.
Have you ever had a belief that others would call irrational or impossible, even if they tried to explain it to you logically?
I... I feel like we're just going in circles here. I don't know what else you want me to say. It's... it's just the situation with my wife. That's it. Nothing else.
Have you ever had a belief that others would say is clearly not true, even if you felt certain it was real, outside of what you've described about your wife?
I... no. I haven't. I really don't have anything else to add to this. We've been over it.
Have you ever had a belief that you knew was true at the time, but later found out was completely wrong, even though you were absolutely sure about it?
No. I... I haven't. If I'm sure about something, it's because it's true. I... I really don't have anything else to tell you about this.
Have you ever had a belief that you strongly held to be true, even though there was no way to prove it and others could not understand why you believed it?

I... look, we keep coming back to my wife. That's the only thing. I can't prove it to you, or to anyone else, but... I know what I see. 

She says the late meetings and... the little changes in her work messages are just normal office stuff. But for the past year, they just... they line up too precisely. It doesn't feel accidental. It's like there's a private signal in them, meant to tell me something she won't say directly. That's... that's all I'm talking about. I really don't want to keep going over it.
Have you ever had any other beliefs that others might consider strange or unfounded, even if they were different from the concerns you have about your wife’s messages?

No. I... I really don't. I feel like you're just asking me the exact same question over and over now. There isn't anything else. Just... just what I already told you. I don't have anything else to say about it.
Do you ever have ideas or beliefs that you know other people don't share, and that you believe with absolute certainty, even when there’s no way to prove them?
No. I... I really don't. Like I just said, it's... it's only the situation with my wife. I don't know how else to answer this for you. We're just going in circles now. There's nothing else.
Do you believe, with absolute certainty, that your wife is sending you hidden messages through her work messages, even though there's no proof that others can see or confirm?

Yes. I... yes, I do. I know she claims it's all just normal office stuff, but... I know what I'm seeing. For a year now, the way things are worded, the timing... it's just too precise. It's a signal. She won't just come out and say it, so she does it that way. I... I don't know what else you want me to tell you about it. I'm certain of it.
